predecessors.name: Parthian Empire
predecessors.text: the Hatra district, a Parthian dependency (the page says 'under Parthian suzerainty')

successors.name: Sasanian Empire
successors.text: Hatra, captured and destroyed in 240/41 by Shapur I

ledger.x: 116/117: Hatra, a Parthian buffer kingdom under Arabian lords, first shows as a power by repulsing Trajan.
116 (the dossier's start, not a page's date): Hatra is a Parthian vassal for its whole life under the Arsacids.

c. 176/177: the lords of Hatra become kings, 'King of the Arabs'. Sanatruq I page: 'He was granted the title of king by his Parthian overlord Vologases IV (r. 147-191)'; his only dated inscription is 176/177. Kingdom of Hatra page: 'From the 170s they adopted malka (king)', linked to Rome's incorporation of Edessa in…
224: the Parthian suzerainty ends with the Arsacid dynasty (Hormozdgan, 28 April 224, Ardashir I page); Hatra then stands alone until it falls in 240/41.
240/41: Shapur I captures and destroys Hatra.

wars.name: Trajan's siege of Hatra
wars.outcome: Hatra repulsed the siege; Trajan withdrew.

wars.name: Severan sieges of Hatra
wars.outcome: Septimius Severus failed to take Hatra, as Trajan had; Abdsamiya had supported Pescennius Niger.

wars.name: Ardashir I's attempts on Hatra
wars.outcome: Ardashir's attempt failed; Hatra withstood him in the 220s.

wars.name: Battle of Shahrazoor
wars.outcome: Hatra's forces defeated the Sasanian Persians.

wars.name: Shapur I's conquest of Hatra
wars.outcome: The capital was captured and destroyed; the kingdom ended.

certainty.note: The territory is not given by any page opened; the disc round Hatra is a placeholder and its edge is soft.
